content.text:
Fixed. `wordFreq` now lower-cases the text and matches words with `/[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)*/g`, so "Hello," and "hello" count as one word and "don't" stays whole. I added a test for apostrophes, and all 4 tests pass.

One thing to look at: `scripts/check-env.js` prints your API key and token in full. It would be safer to print only the last four characters.
